target: Certified regular-election seat winners, combined with pre-election verified holdovers. Chamber organization is a separate dated target.
primaryScope: All partisan regular-election chambers with verified holdovers and complete district seat coverage; upper and lower chambers included.
competitiveSubset: Pre-election maximum pure D/R/Other/Tie seat-majority probability below 0.80. Membership fixed when the forecast is frozen.
excluded: Officially nonpartisan ballots without a separately verified pre-election alignment target
metrics: State joint outcomes where both certified chamber targets are available
benchmarks: No-change seat count and majority category
Earlier-cycle empirical transition probabilities with Dirichlet(1,1,1,1) smoothing
uncertainty: Report cycle-balanced scores and election-cycle clustered uncertainty when enough cycles exist. A single 2026 cycle cannot estimate cycle-level sampling uncertainty; do not substitute independent-chamber confidence intervals.
historicalFullModel: Reconstruct each vintage with dated district maps, candidates, holdovers, polling and source cutoffs. Fit national transfer, incumbency and shared-error components using earlier cycles only. Score later cycles once; no test-outcome selection or fitting. Existing structural and presidential residual studies do not satisfy this protocol.
outcomeRequirements: Separate organization date and source if organization is evaluated
status: Registered; 2026 certified outcomes are not yet available.
